name: FixedCoopSynergies
description: Fixed Coop Synergies: each character gets an active skill (unlocks at level 6, upgrades every 6 levels) on a free button, plus faction affinities that grant a buff and a nerf when related characters team up. A fork of Co-op Synergies by hhoangg (byptah), with stats that can no longer go negative and a faction for every character.
